title: LTO Exam Reviewer 2026 — Non-Professional — 100 Questions (English)
source: Slides from the four-part YouTube reviewer. Wording kept as printed. Questions 27, 58 and 93 are not in these videos.

questions.question: The three colors of the traffic lights are:

options.text: red, green and yellow
red, green and blue
yellow, green and blue

questions.question: Yellow triangular signs provide what kind of information

options.text: warning
hospital across
speed limit

questions.question: Which of the following traffic signs are blue?

options.text: regulatory signs
information signs
danger warning signs

questions.question: Steady green light means

options.text: you must yield to all pedestrians and other motorists using the intersection
go, it is safe to do so
proceed cautiously through the intersection before the light changes to red.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at a road crossing signifies

options.text: Caution — slow down and proceed with caution
Stop and stay until light stops flashing
Wait for the green light

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slopes in towards your left. This shows that

options.text: there is an intersection joint ahead
the road will get narrower
you are approaching a construction area

questions.question: You are in a No-Passing zone when the center of the road is marked by

options.text: a broken yellow line
a broken white line
two solid yellow lines

questions.question: When arrows are painted on the pavement, drivers must:

options.text: must go in the direction of the arrows
slow down and prepare to yield right of way
are not allowed to change lanes

questions.question: You may not drive across solid yellow lines except to:

options.text: change lanes
turn left
turn right

questions.question: Double solid yellow lane lines

options.text: should not be crossed except with due care
should not be crossed anytime
does not allow lane changing

options.text: when turning left into a driveway
when passing to the right on a one-way street

questions.question: You may cross over a double line on the road to overtake another car if the line on your side is:

options.text: solid white
broken
solid yellow

questions.question: When you approach a flashing red signal light, you should:

options.text: wait for the green light before proceeding
slow down and proceed with caution
come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe to do so

questions.question: Which of the following hand signals must a driver give when he wants to slow down and stop?

options.text: left is bent at elbow, hand pointing up
left arm held straight in horizontal position
left arm held down and hand pointing at ground

questions.question: The proper hand signal for right turn is:

options.text: left arm bent at elbow, hand pointing up
left arm held straight in horizontal position
left arm held down and hand pointing at ground

questions.question: If the driver ahead of your extends his left arm straight out, you are fairly sure that he is going to:

options.text: turn left at the next intersection
pull off to the side of the road to stop
turn right at the next intersection

questions.question: When approaching a railway crossing with a signal device warning the approach of a train, you must:

options.text: stop not less than 1.5 meters from the nearest rail
slow down and proceed with caution
pull off to the side of the road to stop

questions.question: Under what circumstances should you sound your "horn"?

options.text: as a safety warning
at school zones
at hospital zones

questions.question: What does the lane require you to do upon approaching an intersection with a stop sign?

options.text: slow down and proceed when it is safe to do so
stop and proceed when it is safe to do so
yield the right-of-way if necessary to vehicles approaching from left or right

questions.question: Upon approaching an intersection marked with a YIELD SIGN, you are required to:

options.text: stop before entering the intersection
enter the intersection immediately
slow down then enter the intersection when the way is clear

questions.question: The road sign "Do Not Enter" is a:

options.text: Regulatory sign
Guide sign
Warning sign

questions.question: The Right-of-Way law provides us with:

options.text: basic rights as drivers
rules for when to yield to others
rules for turning right

questions.question: A good safety rule when you are sure you have the legal right-of-way is:

options.text: never believe on it
sound your horn to alert others
always demand

options.text: vehicles which are just about to enter
vehicles within the rotunda

questions.question: At an intersection with no control device, two cars approach at right angles to each other. Which driver must yield?

options.text: the driver who gets there first
the driver who slows down first
the driver who gets there last

questions.question: At an intersection without a control device, two cars are approaching from opposite directions at the same time, one is turning left and the other turning right. Which driver must yield?

options.text: the driver turning right
the driver turning left
the driver who gets there first

options.text: the car on the right
the car on the left
the car that slows down first

questions.question: A car is positioned in an intersection waiting to turn left when the traffic signal light turns red. Who should go first?

options.text: the driver caught in the intersection waiting to turn left
the driver making the right turn
the driver caught with the green light

questions.question: At an intersection without stop or yield signs, two cars approach from different streets. Which car has the right-of-way?

options.text: the vehicle already in the intersection
the vehicle on the left
the vehicle that slows down first

questions.question: The driver of a car traveling on a highway is required to yield to

options.text: any car coming out of a driveway
pedestrian
cars approaching an intersection from the left

options.text: until at least two cars have passed
which are close enough to be dangerous
until five cars have passed

options.text: stop and give way only to persons crossing from your right
stop only for children and give way to them

options.text: Yes, a driver turning right or left must give way to pedestrians
No, pedestrians must give way to all vehicles
Yes, but only if the driver is turning left

options.text: pull to the right and stop
speed up to get out of the way
continue at high speed

questions.question: When two vehicles meet on an upgrade road where neither cars pass, which of the two must yield?

options.text: the vehicle facing downhill
the vehicle facing uphills
the vehicle that blow its horn first

options.text: turn your head to check other vehicles beside your car
sound your horn
blink your headlight

questions.question: You should change lanes only after you have

options.text: signaled your intention and checked traffic
signaled your intention
checked traffic

options.text: the driver you have passed honks his horn
you can see in your rear-view mirror the car you have passed
you can see in your side-view mirror the car you have passed

options.text: if the highway is clearly marked for two or more lanes moving towards the same direction
on a road having one lane in opposite direction
by driving off the paved roadway

options.text: make the turn as quickly as possible
brake or clutch while actually turning
look behind on both sides and see if it is safe before you change lane

questions.question: You should begin signaling for a right or left turn before reaching the turning point by at least

options.text: 30 meters
60 meters
15 meters

questions.question: You should normally begin a right turn on

options.text: the lane nearest to the road center
the lane nearest the right curb
the same lane as for a left turn

questions.question: The car behind you wants to pass. You should

options.text: blow you horn to allow him to pass
slow down slightly and pull to the right
pull to the right and stop as he can pass

questions.question: When driving on the highway at night, you should use low beam headlights (dim lights) when

options.text: another driver dims his lights
blinded by the headlights of an approaching vehicle
all of the above

options.text: release accelerator and prepare to brake
apply your brakes as soon as possible
increase your speed

options.text: stop in the crosswalk
signal at least 30 meters ahead of your turn
watch for pedestrians on the street you are about to enter

options.text: he cannot see oncoming vehicles form the other side of the bridge
there are pedestrians crossing
he might obstruct the flow of traffic

options.text: to signal your intention as you make the turn
to give the electrical and/or hand signal at least 30 meters before you make the turn
to disregard signaling if there is no traffic ahead or behind you.

questions.question: Using the shoulder of the road pass to the right of a car ahead of you is

options.text: allowed if you are turning right
allowed if the car ahead is turning left
against the law

questions.question: Which of the following is not a safe place to overtake?

options.text: when approaching a bridge or upon a curve
at an intersection
both of the above

questions.question: A left turn is more dangerous than a right turn because

options.text: cars from the right are moving faster
you have to be alert for vehicles coming from both left and right
four-lane streets are wider than two-lane streets

questions.question: What light shall be used when vehicles are parked on the highway at night?

options.text: headlight
parking lights or lower-beam headlights
signal lights

questions.question: Parking lights may used

options.text: at anytime
for parking and when visibility is poor
when driving on a well-lighted streets

questions.question: We consider a vehicle parked when

options.text: it has brought to stop on the shoulder of a highway and remains inactive in a place for a period of time
it stops to discharge/take in waiting passengers
it loads/unloads small quantity or freight with reasonable dispatch and moves away without delay

questions.question: When parking downhill, you should turn your front wheels

options.text: into the curb or toward the side of the road
away from the curb
any direction will do

options.text: get close to the curb and turn the front wheels away from curb
turn wheels sharply to the left
turn wheels sharply to the right

options.text: check other traffic, signal and pull from curb when it is safe to do so
signal and pull from curb
sound your horn and pull from curb slowly

questions.question: You may never park

options.text: on a crosswalk
on a one-way street
within 5 meters of a fire hydrant

questions.question: When you intend to drive faster than the other vehicles, you should use the

options.text: outermost (right) lane
center lane
innermost (left) lane

questions.question: When loading or unloading passengers, we usually stop at the

options.text: right side of the road nearest the sidewalk
middle side of the road
intersection

questions.question: Which of the following is the maximum speed limit on the expressway?

options.text: 60 kph
80 kph
100 kph

questions.question: A driver may load and unload passengers

options.text: only at designated stops
whenever a passenger signals for a stop
before an intersection

options.text: notch effectively the hand brake
shift the gear to neutral
close the windows

questions.question: When using the basic speed law as a guide, the choice of speed will be based

options.text: speed of the driver
fuel of car being driven
traffic and road condition

questions.question: When you intend to drive slower than the other vehicles, you should use the

options.text: outermost (right) lane
center lane
innermost (left) lane

questions.question: The speed limit within a school zone during school days is

options.text: 20 kph
25 kph
30 kph

questions.question: Under the basic speed law, you may never drive faster than

options.text: that which is safe
the posted limit
the flow of traffic

questions.question: It is more dangerous to drive at the maximum speed limit at night than during daytime because

options.text: your reaction time is slower at night
the roadways are more apt to be slippery at night
you cannot see too far ahead at night

options.text: depends on the road and weather condition
is the posted speed limit
depends on the mechanical skill of the driver

questions.question: Night driving is dangerous because

options.text: street lights tend to blur your vision
more vehicles are on the road at night
the distance we can see ahead is reduced

questions.question: At night, you should never drive at a speed which would prevent you from stopping within the distance

of a 4 car-lengths

options.text: the recommended speed under the best condition
the recommended speed under the worst condition
the recommended speed under any condition

options.text: space for one car

one-car length per 10 miles of speed

options.text: pull off the road and rest
move over to the right lane and continue driving
increase your speed to get away from other vehicles

options.text: decrease speed before entering the curve
increase speed while negotiating the curve

involve you in fatal accident

options.text: drive slowly
drive defensively
take chances if possible

questions.question: Drivers gather most information with their

options.text: cars
eyes
hands

eat much and drink a little alcoholic beverages
take an over-the-counter "keep awake" pill

options.text: ground viewing
moving your eyes regularly by looking near and far
another car's speed

questions.question: Which of the following can you adjust in order to reduce the chance of collision?

options.text: your speed and lane position
the sharpness of a curve
another car's speed

questions.question: Drivers have to make decisions

options.text: only in heavy traffic
only until they become experienced
continuously as they drive

questions.question: When interacting with bicyclists, you must

options.text: be more aware of the road condition
adjust speed and increase your space margin

questions.question: As you drive, your glances to the side and rear view mirrors should be

options.text: as brief as possible
as long as you like
at least one second each

questions.question: At night when you meet another vehicle with blinding bright lights, the safest thing to do is

options.text: turn your lights on high beam
look slightly to the right side of the roadway
look at the headlight of the approaching vehicle

options.text: keep as close as possible to the car ahead
proceed slowly into the intersection until the traffic ahead moves on

options.text: forbidden at all times
forbidden only in the province
forbidden only in the cities

position your car slightly to the left

options.text: on the left side of the road facing traffic
on the right side

keep the victim lying down

give the inspector a chance to look at your car
try and make sure that cars meet the safety standards

non-professional license
professional license

options.text: an honor
a right
a privilege

options.text: under no circumstance
to another person who is learning to drive
